entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 6 months after the date you arrive in Cape Verde.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe vencer al menos 6 meses después de la fecha de llegada a Cabo Verde.
entry.quote: To enter Cape Verde, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: You can enter Cape Verde as a visitor for up to 30 days without a visa.
entry.es: Puedes entrar a Cabo Verde como visitante hasta por 30 días sin visa.
entry.quote: You can enter Cape Verde as a visitor for up to 30 days without a visa.

entry.en: You must fill in a traveller entry form at least 5 days before arrival and pay the airport security fee (TSA) on the official online platform.
entry.es: Debes llenar un formulario de entrada al menos 5 días antes de llegar y pagar la tasa de seguridad aeroportuaria (TSA) en la plataforma oficial en línea.
entry.quote: You must fill in a traveller entry form at least 5 days before you arrive in the country. Complete the pre-registration and pay the airport security fee (‘TSA’) on the official online platform.

entry.en: From 1 July 2026, travellers without the pre-registration or proof of it will have to pay double the TSA fee at border control.
entry.es: Desde el 1 de julio de 2026, quien no complete el prerregistro o no pueda mostrar comprobante pagará el doble de la tasa TSA en el control fronterizo.
entry.quote: From 1 July 2026, if you do not complete the pre-registration or cannot show proof, you will have to pay double the TSA fee at border control.

entry.en: Children aged 17 and under travelling alone or with someone who is not their parent or guardian must carry a letter of authorisation.
entry.es: Los menores de 17 años o menos que viajen solos o con alguien que no sea su padre, madre o tutor deben llevar una carta de autorización.
entry.quote: Children aged 17 and under travelling to Cape Verde alone, or with a person who is not their parent or legal guardian, must carry a letter of authorisation to travel from their parent or guardian.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se requiere un certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si vienes de un país catalogado como de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

safety.en: Crime is generally low but includes pickpocketing, bag snatching, burglary and muggings, particularly in Praia and on Sal and Boa Vista.
safety.es: El crimen es generalmente bajo, pero incluye carterismo, arrebato de bolsos, robos y asaltos, sobre todo en Praia y en las islas de Sal y Boa Vista.
safety.quote: The crime rate in Cape Verde is generally low, but can include pickpocketing, bag snatching, burglary and muggings, particularly in the capital city of Praia and on the islands of Sal and Boa Vista.

safety.en: If you go into the water, always use beaches where a lifeguard is on duty.
safety.es: Si vas a entrar al agua, usa siempre playas con salvavidas de guardia.
safety.quote: If you are going into the water, always use beaches where there is a lifeguard on duty.

safety.en: Only hire authorised taxis from taxi ranks or by asking your hotel to call one.
safety.es: Contrata solo taxis autorizados en paradas de taxis o pidiendo a tu hotel que llame a uno.
safety.quote: Only hire authorised taxis from taxi ranks or by asking your hotel to call one.

safety.en: Sea conditions around Cape Verde can be dangerous, so follow local advice before travelling by sea.
safety.es: Las condiciones del mar alrededor de Cabo Verde pueden ser peligrosas, así que sigue los consejos locales antes de viajar por mar.
safety.quote: Sea conditions around Cape Verde can be dangerous. Follow local advice before travelling by sea.

safety.en: The rainy season runs from mid-August to mid-October, and torrential rains on some islands can cause floods and landslides.
safety.es: La temporada de lluvias va de mediados de agosto a mediados de octubre, y las lluvias torrenciales en algunas islas pueden causar inundaciones y deslizamientos.
safety.quote: The rainy season in Cape Verde is from mid-August to mid-October. Torrential rains on some of the islands can cause floodings and landslides.

safety.en: There are severe penalties for possessing, using or trafficking drugs.
safety.es: Hay penas severas por poseer, consumir o traficar drogas.
safety.quote: There are severe penalties for possessing, using or trafficking drugs.

health.en: Health care in Cape Verde is very basic and limited.
health.es: La atención médica en Cabo Verde es muy básica y limitada.
health.quote: Health care in Cape Verde is very basic and limited

health.en: Global Health Insurance Cards (GHIC) are not accepted in Cape Verde, so appropriate travel insurance is essential.
health.es: Las tarjetas sanitarias GHIC no se aceptan en Cabo Verde, por lo que es esencial tener un seguro de viaje adecuado.
health.quote: Global Health Insurance Cards (GHIC) are not accepted in Cape Verde so it is essential that you have appropriate travel insurance.

health.en: Brava and Santo Antão have no working airports, so medical air evacuation there is extremely difficult.
health.es: Brava y Santo Antão no tienen aeropuertos en funcionamiento, por lo que la evacuación médica aérea es extremadamente difícil.
health.quote: The islands of Brava and Santo Antão do not have working airports, so medical air evacuation is extremely difficult.

health.en: The government has raised the civil protection warning level for dengue on Santiago, Fogo and Brava.
health.es: El gobierno ha elevado el nivel de alerta de protección civil por dengue en Santiago, Fogo y Brava.
health.quote: The Cape Verde government has raised the civil protection warning level for dengue on the islands of Santiago, Fogo and Brava.

health.en: There is still a risk of gastrointestinal illness, as in other countries.
health.es: Sigue existiendo riesgo de enfermedad gastrointestinal, como en otros países.
health.quote: there is still a risk of gastrointestinal illness as in other countries.

health.en: In resorts the tap water is usually desalinated and safe to drink, while elsewhere bottled water is cheap and commonly available.
health.es: En los resorts el agua del grifo suele estar desalinizada y es potable, mientras que en otras zonas el agua embotellada es barata y fácil de conseguir.
health.quote: In the resorts, the tap water is usually desalinated and safe to drink. In other areas, bottled water is cheap and commonly available.

help.en: The emergency numbers are 130 for ambulance, 131 for fire and 132 for police.
help.es: Los números de emergencia son 130 para ambulancia, 131 para bomberos y 132 para policía.

help.en: For a medical emergency, call 130 and ask for an ambulance.
help.es: En una emergencia médica, llama al 130 y pide una ambulancia.
help.quote: Call 130 and ask for an ambulance.

getting_in.en: Cape Verde has four international airports, including Amílcar Cabral on Sal (SID) and Nelson Mandela in Praia (RAI).
getting_in.es: Cabo Verde tiene cuatro aeropuertos internacionales, entre ellos Amílcar Cabral en Sal (SID) y Nelson Mandela en Praia (RAI).
getting_in.quote: Cape Verde has four international airports: Amílcar Cabral International Airport on Sal Island (IATA SID). Nelson Mandela International Airport in Praia on Santiago (Cape Verde) (IATA RAI).

getting_in.en: There are regular flights from Amsterdam, Lisbon (daily), Madrid, Milan, Munich and Oporto.
getting_in.es: Hay vuelos regulares desde Ámsterdam, Lisboa (diarios), Madrid, Milán, Múnich y Oporto.
getting_in.quote: There are regular flights from Amsterdam Schiphol, Lisbon (daily), Madrid Barajas, Milan, Munich Airport, and Oporto.

getting_in.en: There are regular weekly flights from Fortaleza (Brazil).
getting_in.es: Hay vuelos semanales regulares desde Fortaleza (Brasil).
getting_in.quote: There are regular weekly flights from Fortaleza (Brazil).

getting_in.en: There are only infrequent, expensive connections to the mainland by ship.
getting_in.es: Solo hay conexiones marítimas poco frecuentes y caras con el continente.
getting_in.quote: There are only infrequent, expensive connections to the mainland by ship.

getting_in.en: European Union citizens are visa exempt but have to pay an entry fee of approximately €30.
getting_in.es: Los ciudadanos de la Unión Europea están exentos de visa pero deben pagar una tarifa de entrada de aproximadamente 30 €.
getting_in.quote: European Union citizens are also visa exempt, but have to pay an entry fee of approximately €30.

getting_in.en: Other nationalities may obtain a visa on arrival at a cost of around €30.
getting_in.es: Las demás nacionalidades pueden obtener una visa a la llegada por unos 30 €.
getting_in.quote: Everybody else may obtain a visa on arrival at a cost of around €30.

getting_around.en: Timetables are not to be taken too seriously: boats may depart early and flights may be postponed until the next day.
getting_around.es: Los horarios no hay que tomarlos muy en serio: los barcos pueden salir antes de tiempo y los vuelos pueden posponerse hasta el día siguiente.
getting_around.quote: Timetables in Cape Verde are not to be taken too seriously - don't be too surprised if that boat departs ahead of schedule or if that flight suddenly gets postponed until tomorrow.

getting_around.en: As of April 2026, CV Sky has regular daily flights between the majority of the islands.
getting_around.es: A abril de 2026, CV Sky tiene vuelos diarios regulares entre la mayoría de las islas.
getting_around.quote: As of April 2026, CV Sky has regular daily flights between the majority of the islands.

getting_around.en: As of July 2022, all inter-island ferries are operated by CV Interilhas.
getting_around.es: A julio de 2022, todos los transbordadores entre islas son operados por CV Interilhas.
getting_around.quote: As of July 2022, all ferries are operated by CV Interilhas.

getting_around.en: Taxis are available in the major cities and are not metered.
getting_around.es: Hay taxis en las ciudades principales y no tienen taxímetro.
getting_around.quote: Nice, new taxis are available in the major cities and are not metered.

getting_around.en: Aluguers are shared pickup trucks or vans available on each island.
getting_around.es: Los aluguers son camionetas o vans compartidas disponibles en cada isla.
getting_around.quote: Shared transportation called Aluguers are available on each island. These are usually either Toyota Hilux open-back pickup trucks with bench seats and sunroof or 15-passenger Toyota Hiace vans.

getting_around.en: Road and sidewalk cobblestones are generally unsuitable for wheeled luggage, baby strollers and folding bicycles.
getting_around.es: Los adoquines de calles y banquetas generalmente no son aptos para maletas con ruedas, carriolas ni bicicletas plegables.
getting_around.quote: These surfaces are generally unsuitable for wheeled luggage, baby strollers, folding bicycles or anything with wheels smaller than those of a car or standard bicycle.

money.en: The currency code is CVE, and the escudo is fixed against the euro at 110 per euro.
money.es: El código de la moneda es CVE, y el escudo tiene un tipo de cambio fijo de 110 por euro.
money.quote: Its ISO code is CVE. The currency is fixed against the euro at 110 per euro.

money.en: On the resort islands of Sal and Boa Vista euros are commonly accepted, although change may be given in escudos.
money.es: En las islas turísticas de Sal y Boa Vista se aceptan euros con frecuencia, aunque el cambio puede darse en escudos.
money.quote: In the resort islands of Sal and Boa Vista, euros are commonly accepted, although you might receive change in escudos.

money.en: Larger towns have ATMs that take Visa, MasterCard and Maestro.
money.es: Las ciudades más grandes tienen cajeros que aceptan Visa, MasterCard y Maestro.
money.quote: Larger towns also have ATMs that will take Visa, MasterCard and Maestro.

money.en: High-end hotels accept credit or debit cards, while other hotels will expect cash.
money.es: Los hoteles de gama alta aceptan tarjetas de crédito o débito, mientras que otros hoteles esperan efectivo.
money.quote: High-end hotels will accept credit/debit cards. Other hotels will expect cash

money.en: Money can be changed at the international airports at Sal and Praia.
money.es: Se puede cambiar dinero en los aeropuertos internacionales de Sal y Praia.
money.quote: Money can be changed from all major currencies at the international airports at Sal and Praia.

money.en: Since most goods are imported, the cost of living is moderate to high.
money.es: Como la mayoría de los productos son importados, el costo de vida es de moderado a alto.
money.quote: Since most goods are imported, the cost of living is moderate to high.

etiquette.en: People are polite and friendly, and it is good to buy something but important to bargain.
etiquette.es: La gente es cortés y amable, y es bueno comprar algo pero importante regatear.
etiquette.quote: People are polite and friendly. It is good to buy something, but important to bargain.

etiquette.en: Even English speakers will highly appreciate any attempt to speak Kriolu or Portuguese.
etiquette.es: Incluso quienes hablan inglés apreciarán mucho cualquier intento de hablar criollo o portugués.
etiquette.quote: even those who can speak English will highly appreciate any attempt you do to speak Kriolu or Portuguese.

connectivity.en: There is mobile phone coverage in all cities and most towns.
connectivity.es: Hay cobertura de telefonía móvil en todas las ciudades y en la mayoría de los pueblos.
connectivity.quote: There is mobile phone coverage in all cities and most towns.

connectivity.en: Local prepaid SIM cards branded CVMovel and Unitel T+ (Tmais) are widely available.
connectivity.es: Las SIM de prepago locales de las marcas CVMovel y Unitel T+ (Tmais) están ampliamente disponibles.
connectivity.quote: Alternatively, local prepaid SIM cards branded CVMovel and Unitel T+ (Tmais) are available widespread.

connectivity.en: You should ask the staff to activate the SIM card and the prepaid tariffs for you.
connectivity.es: Conviene pedir al personal que active la SIM y las tarifas de prepago por ti.
connectivity.quote: Ask the personnel to activate the SIM card for you and to activate the prepaid tariffs.

connectivity.en: As of July 2022, 4G coverage is common in some populated areas such as Santiago and Fogo.
connectivity.es: A julio de 2022, la cobertura 4G es común en algunas zonas pobladas como Santiago y Fogo.
connectivity.quote: As of July 2022, 4G coverage is common in some populated areas such as Santiago and Fogo.
